notes: One picture family: media.made.sky, five times in different crops - behind the opening, under the steps' picture, in the lower left of the sideways run, round the plan cards and between the closing button and the foot. A dark page skips a light-toned sky. land, blur, sheet and field are not used.
links[] carry the sideways panels (one screen each); without links the run starts at the wheel. figures, plans, faq, close and a film are optional.

The page holds the scroll in three places at 1024 and wider (opening 1800 px, steps 250 + 420 a step + 120, sideways run 1.6 px a px + 330 a feature + 260); a client with many features lengthens the last one.
A place (restaurant, hotel, shop) is not a fit.
